entries.origin_note: Codex detected its own Toronto conversion error during publication verification. No new football selection or operator influence.
entries.title: Clock correction to new Codex integration record
entries.question: Later annotation: what was the actual Toronto decision clock?
entries.why_it_matters: UTC and local decision clocks must identify the same instant.
findings: Original recorded_at_utc 2026-11-10T15:00:23.742Z is valid. Original recorded_at_toronto 2026-11-10T15:00:23.742-05:00 is wrong; correct America/Toronto clock is 2026-11-10T10:00:23.742-05:00. A hardcoded hour replacement did not apply after UTC changed from14 to15.
interpretation: This is a source/constraint correction to local clock formatting only. UTC decision, evidence retrieval/publication clocks, picks, salary totals, expectation UTC clocks, original contributions and deadline remain unchanged.
uncertainty: No historical clock reconstructed; this annotation uses the actually archived UTC decision.
carry_forward: Use timezone conversion rather than an hour-string replacement. Retain this failure and predecessor.

sources.label: Immutable integration UTC timestamp
